upgrades.name: 👑 Royal Throne
upgrades.description: Carved from the finest oak. Cements your reign.

upgrades.name: 🌱 Axe Handling
upgrades.description: +1 base 🪵/sec per level.

upgrades.name: 🌱 Sharpen Axe
upgrades.description: ×1.1 base 🪵/sec per level.

upgrades.name: 🌱 Wood Bank
upgrades.description: +1% base 🪵/sec for every 1,000 🪵 you hold.

upgrades.name: 🌱 Brewing for Dummies
upgrades.description: +1 base 🍺/sec per level.

upgrades.name: 🌱 Secret Recipe
upgrades.description: ×1.1 base 🍺/sec per level.

upgrades.name: 🌱 Ale Bank
upgrades.description: +1% base 🍺/sec for every 1,000 🍺 you hold.

upgrades.name: 🌳 Work Optimization
upgrades.description: ×1.1 production of all resources per level.

upgrades.name: 🌳 Timed Schedule
upgrades.description: All production grows the longer you own this: +10% per minute since purchase, up to ×10.

upgrades.name: 🌳 Better Timing
upgrades.description: Timed Schedule grows +10% per minute faster, per level. Each level only counts time from when you buy it.

upgrades.name: 🌳 Retro Time
upgrades.description: Better Timing levels count all the time since you bought Timed Schedule, not just since each level — an instant boost.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ First Generation
upgrades.description: Unlock the Generators panel with Woodcutters (🪵) and Brewers (🍺).

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Stronger Woodcutters
upgrades.description: +1 🪵/sec per Woodcutter, per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Efficient Woodcutters
upgrades.description: ×1.1 Woodcutter output per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Cheaper Woodcutters
upgrades.description: Woodcutters cost 10% less per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Bulk Woodcutters
upgrades.description: Woodcutter price growth −15% per level, starting with your next Woodcutter.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Bulk Brewers
upgrades.description: Brewer price growth −15% per level, starting with your next Brewer.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Cheaper Brewers
upgrades.description: Brewers cost 10% less per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Efficient Brewers
upgrades.description: ×1.1 Brewer output per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Stronger Brewers
upgrades.description: +1 🍺/sec per Brewer, per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Second Generation
upgrades.description: Unlock Sawmills (🪵) and Taverns (🍺).

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Stronger Sawmills
upgrades.description: +1 🪵/sec per Sawmill, per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Efficient Sawmills
upgrades.description: ×1.1 Sawmill output per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Cheaper Sawmills
upgrades.description: Sawmills cost 10% less per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Bulk Sawmills
upgrades.description: Sawmill price growth −10% per level, starting with your next Sawmill.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Stronger Taverns
upgrades.description: +1 🍺/sec per Tavern, per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Efficient Taverns
upgrades.description: ×1.1 Tavern output per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Cheaper Taverns
upgrades.description: Taverns cost 10% less per level.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Bulk Taverns
upgrades.description: Tavern price growth −10% per level, starting with your next Tavern.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Pyramid
upgrades.description: Each generator type produces +10% more for every generator you own of the types below it (Woodcutter → Brewer → Sawmill → Tavern). Exclusive with Socialism and Capitalism.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Socialism
upgrades.description: All production up to ×2, growing the more evenly your generators are owned — full bonus when you own the same number of each. Exclusive with Pyramid and Capitalism.

upgrades.name: ⚙️ Capitalism
upgrades.description: Your most-owned generator type produces ×3. Exclusive with Pyramid and Socialism.

upgrades.name: 🖱️ Click
upgrades.description: Unlock clicking: earn 1 resource per click.

upgrades.name: 🖱️ Stronger Click
upgrades.description: +1 per click, per level.

upgrades.name: 🖱️ Smarter Click
upgrades.description: ×1.1 per-click income per level.

upgrades.name: 🖱️ Power Clicks
upgrades.description: Your production rate boosts your click power. Exclusive with Click Momentum.

upgrades.name: 🖱️ Click Momentum
upgrades.description: Your clicking boosts all your production. Exclusive with Power Clicks.

upgrades.name: 🔎 Highlight
upgrades.description: Unlock highlighting: the resource you highlight is produced ×2.

upgrades.name: 🔎 Clearer Lens
upgrades.description: ×1.1 highlight bonus per level.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Lantern
upgrades.description: Unlock the lantern: it refills while nothing is highlighted and burns while a resource is. Highlight income is ×1.5 while it holds oil.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Brighter Flame
upgrades.description: The lit lantern boosts highlight income by a further +0.25×.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Bigger Reservoir
upgrades.description: The lantern holds 5 more oil, so it burns 5 seconds longer.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Quicker Refill
upgrades.description: Refill 0.5 more oil per second while nothing is highlighted.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Slower Burn
upgrades.description: Burn 10% less oil per second while a resource is highlighted.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Full Flame
upgrades.description: +0.5× more while the lantern is at least three-quarters full. Rewards short bursts.

upgrades.name: 🪔 Last Drop
upgrades.description: +0.5× more while the lantern is down to its last quarter. Rewards long holds.

upgrades.name: 🏛️ Bank
upgrades.description: Unlock the Bank.

upgrades.name: 💥 Warfare
upgrades.description: Unlock the Attack panel.

upgrades.name: 🌍 Diplomacy
upgrades.description: Unlock the Relations panel, where you sign pacts.

upgrades.name: 🕵 First Spy
upgrades.description: Unlock the Espionage panel and see the enemy's 🪵.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Better Spy
upgrades.description: See the enemy's 🪵 per second.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Second Spy
upgrades.description: See the enemy's 🍺.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Better Second Spy
upgrades.description: See the enemy's 🍺 per second.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Click Counter
upgrades.description: See the enemy's peak clicks per second.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Purchase Receipts
upgrades.description: Get notified whenever the enemy buys an upgrade or a generator.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Itemized Receipts
upgrades.description: Notifications say whether the enemy bought an upgrade or a generator.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Know the Generator
upgrades.description: Notifications name the generator the enemy bought.

upgrades.name: 🕵 Know the Upgrade
upgrades.description: Notifications name the upgrade the enemy bought.

upgrades.name: 🛡️ Early warning
upgrades.description: Get warned 5 seconds before an enemy attack lands on you. Unlocks after you have been hit once.

upgrades.name: 🛡️ Longer warning
upgrades.description: +1 second of warning per level.

upgrades.name: 🛡️ Know the attack
upgrades.description: The warning names the incoming attack.

upgrades.name: 🖱️ Gotta Click Fast
upgrades.description: +1 click income for every click/sec of your peak click speed.

upgrades.name: 🪓 Steal Wood
upgrades.description: Unlock Steal Wood: take 10% of the enemy's 🪵.

upgrades.name: 🍺 Ale Heist
upgrades.description: Unlock Ale Heist: take up to 500 of the enemy's 🍺.

upgrades.name: 🍄 Dry Rot
upgrades.description: Unlock Dry Rot: a passive attack that cuts the enemy's 🪵 production by 10%.

upgrades.name: 🪓 Raid Woodcutters
upgrades.description: Unlock Raid Woodcutters: steal half the enemy's Woodcutters.

upgrades.name: 🏗️ Poach Sawmill
upgrades.description: Unlock Poach Sawmill: steal one of the enemy's Sawmills.

upgrades.name: 💥 Click Sabotage
upgrades.description: Unlock Less Click Power and Less Click Power (flat): two passive attacks that cut the enemy's click income.

upgrades.name: 🌫️ Highlight Sabotage
upgrades.description: Unlock Dim Highlight and Dim Highlight (flat): two passive attacks that weaken the enemy's highlight.

upgrades.name: 🏮 Borrowed Glow
upgrades.description: Sign Borrowed Glow: your highlight grows with the enemy's peak click speed.

upgrades.name: 🔎 Shared Lens
upgrades.description: Sign Shared Lens: +2 click income per enemy Clearer Lens level, both ways.

upgrades.name: 📜 Shared research
upgrades.description: Sign Shared research: upgrades the enemy owns cost you 25% less.

upgrades.name: 🪵 Trade route
upgrades.description: Sign Trade route: +2% wood per enemy woodcutter, both ways.

upgrades.name: ✋ Numb Hands
upgrades.description: Unlock Numb Hands: a 15s click blackout.

upgrades.name: 🌫️ Fog of War
upgrades.description: Unlock Fog of War: halve their highlight for 8s.

upgrades.name: 🐛 Termite Swarm
upgrades.description: Unlock Termite Swarm: −22% enemy Wood for 67s.

upgrades.name: ⚔️ War Room
upgrades.description: +1 active attack slot.

upgrades.name: 🕵️ Spy Network
upgrades.description: +2 passive attack slots.

upgrades.name: 🏰 Siege Camp
upgrades.description: +1 more active attack slot.

upgrades.name: 🚫 Embargo
upgrades.description: Unlock Embargo: the enemy can buy nothing for 10s.

upgrades.name: Drum Accord
upgrades.description: Unlock the Drum Accord pact.

attacks.name: Steal Wood
attacks.description: Steal 10% of the enemy's Wood. (does not affect score)

attacks.name: Ale Heist
attacks.description: Steal up to 500 of the enemy's Ale. (does not affect score)

attacks.name: Dry Rot
attacks.description: Passively reduces the enemy's Wood production by 10% while unlocked.

attacks.name: Raid Woodcutters
attacks.description: Steal half the enemy's Woodcutters — they produce for you from now on. (does not affect score)

attacks.name: Poach Sawmill
attacks.description: Steal one of the enemy's Sawmills, even one you haven't unlocked yourself. (does not affect score)

attacks.name: Less Click Power
attacks.description: Passively halves the enemy's per-click income while unlocked.

attacks.name: Less Click Power (flat)
attacks.description: Passively takes a flat 2 off the enemy's per-click income while unlocked.

attacks.name: Dim Highlight
attacks.description: Passively cuts the enemy's highlight bonus in half while unlocked.

attacks.name: Dim Highlight (flat)
attacks.description: Passively subtracts 1 from the enemy's highlight factor while unlocked — enough to cancel a small highlight's bonus, though never below a neutral ×1.

attacks.name: Fog of War
attacks.description: Halves the enemy's highlight bonus for 8s.

attacks.name: Embargo
attacks.description: The enemy cannot buy upgrades or generators for 10s. Time it for when they are saving up.

pacts.name: Borrowed Glow
pacts.description: Your highlight grows with the enemy's fastest clicking: +120% per click/s of their peak.

pacts.name: Shared Lens
pacts.description: +2 click income per level of the enemy's Clearer Lens. The enemy gains the same from yours.

pacts.name: Shared research
pacts.description: Upgrades the enemy already owns cost 25% less for you, while they stay ahead.

pacts.name: Trade route
pacts.description: +2% wood per enemy woodcutter, up to +50%. The enemy gains the same from yours.

pacts.name: Drum Accord
pacts.description: Your clicks are worth ×2 for 15s — but the enemy gets 3 automatic clicks per second for as long.
